main_text.l: quibus interdum venia opus non fit. In
est, qui tam bene animum suum disciplinis
possit aut fallere. Parati profecto sumus
nione induere non est nostrum. Ipsi
nos si quando errores nostros odorati
mus, ne quis forte studio nostri
rere non potui; Norunt alii, qualia

page.notes: The Greek words in the line "In omnibus" are only approximately reproduced and are uncertain [?]. The page is rather damaged by stains at the edges; the last word of the paragraph may continue on the following page.
